entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the two brothers of the war, an apprentice of Tocasia who found the Mightstone and allied with Kroog, ultimately emerging victorious at Argoth.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival, who found the Weakstone, focused on the west and Zegon, and is believed killed at Argoth.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The great teacher who trained Urza and Mishra and took them on a pilgrimage to the Caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A woman from Zegon, once cheerful, later a brutal warlord who joined Mishra's forces; possibly the cause of the brothers' final rift.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's brilliant apprentice, probably from Yotia, who survives the war with Urza.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: An eccentric mage of Lat-Nam who studied the machines with his wife Hurkyl.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife, an adept artificer of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: A figure who traveled to Phyrexia whose discoveries Caldos neglected.

entities.name: Ildria Caldos
entities.description: The Epityr College of Mages history professor who wrote the article reconstructing the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Farsa Tashiir
entities.description: Professor Emeritus of Historical Wizardry at Argivian University who commented on and criticized Caldos's article.

entities.name: Kathy Ice
entities.description: The translator of the article from the Argivian.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that devastated Terisiare and destroyed Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A forested island continent whose resources drew both brothers and which was destroyed in the final battle.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent stripped of resources by the brothers' war machines.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: The caves where Urza and Mishra discovered the Mightstone and Weakstone on a pilgrimage with Tocasia.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: A Thran relic Urza discovered in the caves.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: A Thran relic Mishra discovered in the caves.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The legendary ancient empire whose relics the brothers found.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city whose citizens were among Urza's first allies.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The eastern region where Urza's influence spread and Tawnos likely hailed from.

entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: Ashnod's home city and a focus of Mishra's efforts.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: The western isle where Drafna and Hurkyl studied the machines.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: The city and region whose modern incarnation is named for the ancient one.

entities.name: Videnth
entities.description: The proposed true location of the war under the Videnthian Theory.

entities.name: Videnthian Theory
entities.description: Caldos's theory that the war took place at Greater and Little Videnth rather than Terisiare and Argoth.

entities.name: Epityr College of Mages
entities.description: The college where Caldos is a professor.

events.summary: Caldos challenges the traditional geography of the war and proposes the Videnthian Theory.
events.quote: it is far more likely that ancient Argoth is in fact Little Videnth Island

events.summary: Tocasia takes Urza and Mishra, about sixteen, on a pilgrimage to the Caves of Koilos where they find the Mightstone and Weakstone.
events.quote: Urza discovered the Mightstone, and Mishra, the Weakstone.

events.summary: After the pilgrimage the brothers grow apart, becoming jealous of Tocasia's attention and guarding their secrets.
events.quote: They became increasingly jealous of Tocasia’s attention.

events.summary: Both brothers court Ashnod and suffer a final cataclysmic quarrel, parting forever.
events.quote: they had a final cataclysmic quarrel and parted ways forever.

events.summary: Tocasia dies, removing the brothers' last restraining influence, and the battle is joined in earnest.
events.quote: Shortly thereafter, Tocasia died, ridding the brothers of their final restraining influence.

events.summary: Urza allies with Kroog and spreads influence over Yotia while Mishra works the west and Zegon, where Ashnod joins him as a harsh overlord.
events.quote: Eventually, Ashnod joined him, but what a different Ashnod she was!

events.summary: The brothers' battle becomes an all-consuming war that kills millions and strips Terisiare of resources.
events.quote: Millions of people were killed, slaughtered by one another and by the terrible machines of war.

events.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl study the machines on Lat-Nam, keeping many discoveries secret until after their deaths.
events.quote: Although their separatist views kept many of their discoveries secret until after their death

events.summary: With Terisiare exhausted, both brothers rush to exploit Argoth's forests and mineral wealth.
events.quote: They rushed to exploit it, each certain that possession of the island would assure him of a final victory.

events.summary: In the final months-long battle at Argoth, Urza and Tawnos emerge victorious and the island is a smoking ruin.
events.quote: When he battle was over, Urza and Tawnos emerged victorious, and Argoth was a smoking ruin.

events.summary: Mishra and Ashnod are almost certainly killed, while Urza and Tawnos disappear, perhaps by planeswalking.
events.quote: Mishra and Ashnod were almost certainly killed in the conflagration, but no concrete evidence exists of this.

events.summary: Tashiir rebuts Caldos, arguing no victory was possible and that Urza and Tawnos probably did not survive.
events.quote: Tashiir remarked that there are no subsequent legends of Urza or Tawnos, so it is unlikely they actually survived.
